metaTitle: Custom Full Color Stadium Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color stadium blankets for your brand. Perfect for outdoor events and giveaways at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color printing on stadium blankets lets you reproduce logos, photos, or intricate designs with exceptional detail. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to use gradients, shading, and photographic imagery that makes your brand stand out at tailgates, sporting events, or outdoor corporate gatherings. Choose a soft fleece or woven blanket as your canvas, and we'll apply your artwork using dye sublimation or full color transfer for a vibrant, lasting finish that won't crack or fade.
heroAltText: Custom full color stadium blanket with a detailed logo and gradient design, perfect for outdoor events and giveaways.
